THE 2023 OUTLANDER SPORT > 01 PERFORMANCE
> FEEL- GOOD FUEL EFFICIENC Y
Balancing performance with fuel economy, the Outlander Sport goes
EXPLORE full throttle without guzzling the gas tank. Feel free to roam farther
PERFORMANCE
with a rating of 23 City/29 Highway/26 combined MPG that’s among
best-in-class.3
Optional features shown. Available at additional cost. Photos shown may not represent in-market specifications. Visit mitsubishicars.com for more information.

THE 2023 OUTLANDER SPORT > 02 TECH + COMFORT
> ALL SYSTEMS GO
Get in your Outlander Sport with one touch. With the available
FAST-Key Entry System, you can quickly lock or unlock your
EXPLORE Outlander Sport by simply pressing a button on the door handle.
TECHNOLOGY
Then, the push button start makes it just as easy to get on your way.
To power up, push the start/stop button while applying the brake.
Optional features shown. Available at additional cost. Photos shown may not represent in-market specifications. Visit mitsubishicars.com for more information.

THE 2023 OUTLANDER SPORT > 03 SAFETY
> ADDED BUFFER
The Outlander Sport’s front and side-curtain airbags9 all work
EXPLORE together to safeguard you and your passengers.
SAFETY
In addition to six standard airbags, a seventh airbag is included
underneath the driver’s side dashboard for even more protection.
Optional features shown. Available at additional cost. Photos shown may not represent in-market specifications. Visit mitsubishicars.com for more information.

THE 2023 OUTLANDER SPORT > 04 EXTERIOR DESIGN
> 04 STEP OUT IN ST YLE
As if its safety, technology, and performance features weren’t
enough, the 2023 Outlander Sport has style to boot. The bold front
grille is rounded out perfectly by firm, muscular lines, while sharp,
sleek LED daytime running lights, headlights, and available fog lights
add a touch of athleticism. Its sporty stance conveys style and
presence with a down-to-earth twist.
Optional features shown. Available at additional cost. Photos shown may not represent in-market specifications. Visit mitsubishicars.com for more information.
